scenarios.prompt: A director chooses among several legal entry points using a versioned budget and visibility policy. Define deterministic scheduling identity.

criteria.identity: wave_id/revision, source IDs and pool/table revision are explicit.
criteria.determinism: Tie/fallback and RNG stream behavior are deterministic and replayable.
criteria.idempotency: Duplicate schedule callbacks do not create duplicate entries and visibility/cadence are project data.
